content_units: Kyoto Dinner Fit for Saturday 19:00-21:00
For a   vegetarian-friendly dinner for 4   with   one gluten-avoiding diner   and a budget of   up to 4,500 JPY per person  , the best fit is   Restaurant B  .
Restaurant D   is excellent for dietary needs but falls   over budget  , so it works only as a trade-off backup.
Ranked Restaurant Options
Rank   Restaurant   Avg Price   Vegetarian Fit   Gluten-Free Fit   Saturday Dinner Practicality   Verdict
1     Restaurant B       4,300 JPY       9/10       6/10     Usually quiet; 18-minute walk     Best overall fit
2     Restaurant D       4,700 JPY       10/10       7/10     Reservation required; 22-minute walk     Best dietary backup, but over budget
3     Restaurant A       3,800 JPY       4/10       2/10     Reservation recommended; 12-minute walk   Budget-friendly but weak for both dietary needs
4     Restaurant C       2,100 JPY       5/10       1/10     Often 35-minute wait; 6-minute walk   Cheap and close, but poor fit for gluten avoidance and timing
Option 1:   Restaurant B     Tofu specialty with the strongest balance of vegetarian quality, gluten-aware options, and budget fit     Top choice
Option 2:   Restaurant D     Shojin ryori offers the best dietary compatibility overall, but exceeds the stated budget     Backup choice
Option 3:   Restaurant A     Acceptable on price and distance, but limited vegetarian and gluten-free coverage     Third choice
Option 4:   Restaurant C     Low cost and short walk, but long waits and very weak gluten-free suitability make it the least suitable     Last choice
Best Pick and Backup
Top choice: Restaurant B
- Fits the   budget   at   4,300 JPY per person
- Strongest in-budget score for   vegetarian dining
- Better   gluten-free support   than A or C
-   Usually quiet  , which is helpful for a Saturday dinner window
- Tofu specialty format is likely the most naturally suitable of the in-budget options
Backup choice: Restaurant D
- Best overall for   vegetarian   and   gluten-free   needs
- Main downside:   4,700 JPY per person  , which is   200 JPY over budget
- Also needs a   reservation  , so it is less flexible
- Worth choosing only if dietary confidence matters more than strict budget
Dining Context Used
- Budget cap treated as   strict at 4,500 JPY per person
- “Gluten avoids” interpreted as needing   better gluten-free flexibility  , not just vegetarian availability
- Saturday 19:00-21:00 favors places with   lower wait risk   and clearer reservation expectations
